subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Consultancy engagement on the artificial-intelligence framework
what_would_settle_it: A procurement award notice, terms of reference or signed advisory agreement; the base carries two accounts of a 2026-08-03 meeting and the minister's statement that the research council leads, and no contract, scope of work, procurement route or value, with none listed on the central procurement board

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National high-performance computing facility
what_would_settle_it: A research council or ministry announcement, procurement notice or budget line for a national compute facility; the base carries the council's own statement that its data committee is to provide such centres and that securing computing infrastructure is a next step, and separately that a vendor is building a data centre for artificial-intelligence workloads, with no named facility, site, capacity, cost or operator

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up act
what_would_settle_it: A gazetted act or a published bill; a held source records that at 2026-08-09 no gazetted or tabled start-up legislation could be located and that the nearest policy instrument, the National Informal Economy, Start-ups and Entrepreneurship Development Policy, is not published at any URL, so what is outstanding is confirmation that none exists rather than a document

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Government interoperability framework
what_would_settle_it: A published interoperability framework, standard or governing instrument; the base names three data-exchange objects across ten years and establishes no relationship between them, no operating body and no governance rules

subject: dpi.pay
name: Payments association 2025 annual report
what_would_settle_it: The report itself; the base holds two press accounts of its 2026-07-28 release and no primary, and the association's own site publishes only a memorandum and a board release, so four payment rows stand on press reporting of one unheld document

subject: data.open
name: National open data policy or government portal
what_would_settle_it: A portal address, a dataset catalogue or a policy document; the subject holds nothing for Namibia, and the nearest held material is central bank and statistics agency statements on administrative data, which concern data quality rather than publication

subject: gov.discourse
name: Published draft and consultation record of the Data Protection Bill
what_would_settle_it: A ministry consultation notice, submissions register or committee record; the base carries only two sources on this subject and a researcher's statement that the public had not seen the latest draft at 2025-08-17

subject: gov.protect
name: Smart-city grant agreement and annexures
what_would_settle_it: The signed grant agreement, its annexures, the contractor list and the data architecture; the base carries an opposition member's characterisation and a presidential acknowledgement of the amount, with no instrument text, and does not establish the Chinese disbursing agency

subject: gov.regional
name: Ratification of the continental convention on cyber security and personal data protection
what_would_settle_it: The continental depositary list entry or a Namibian instrument of ratification or accession; the base carries 20 sources on this subject, all bilateral or convened by an industry body, and none names a continental or regional data-governance instrument Namibia has acceded to

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: A named ministry or regulator digital-literacy strategy, curriculum or programme document; the subject carries exactly one Namibian source, the regulator and chamber memorandum of 2026-07-30, which names digital literacy as a workstream with no funding, deliverable or target

subject: finance.budget
name: Information and communications technology ministry budget vote
what_would_settle_it: The ministry's vote in the appropriation bill or its budget-vote motivation speech; the base holds no Namibian technology appropriation of any year, and the one appropriation figure held anywhere in the base is the civil registration department's, on a source tagged to other subjects

subject: finance.new
name: Universal Service Fund annual accounts
what_would_settle_it: The fund's annual report, or the regulator's disclosure of levy receipts and project disbursements; the base establishes the fund exists, its launch month, its initial endowment and two in-kind outputs, all from secondary reporting of ministerial statements, and carries no levy rate, contribution base, receipts or project list

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply plan for the national data centre
what_would_settle_it: A power purchase agreement, grid-connection study or energy annex to the data-centre project proposal; the subject carries one Namibian source, a signed opinion piece arguing the case for hosting compute locally, so there is no held statement of how any planned facility would be powered, at what cost, or by whom
